A '''reinforced combat staff''' was an effective weapon crafted with a solid [[Wood/Legends|wooden]] shaft, flexible metallic core, durable [[Iron/Legends|iron]] surface, and [[Crystal/Legends|crystalline]] balance tabs. The [[Staff/Legends|staff]] was a [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapon]] [[Polearm/Legends|polearm]].

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Reinforced combat staffs appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
